[[Crewman]] '''Vyson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] aboard the ''[[FarStar]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was killed when the ship was hit by a [[lightstorm]] in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]].
